caption: The drawing depicts two objects that are elongated and taper towards one end; they both have a cream or pale-colored background with brown borders. Each object has brown fringe at the broader end. Both also feature a central floral design near the wider base comprising a pink flower with a yellow center, surrounded by green leaves. The larger object, on the left, has a small green and brown stitched embellishment at the narrower end, and the overall shape is longer with the same floral and fringe pattern as the smaller one. The smaller object, on the right, is similar in composition but shorter and slightly broader relative to its length, also with the pink flower, green leaves, and brown fringe. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white. There is a faint handwritten inscription near the bottom right corner.
title: Mission Stole and Maniple
